notes: True sloped/diagonal corridor shell shared by rendering, convex collision, shots, placement and navigation.
Body traversal covers up/down, diagonal both ways, combined offsets, maximum slope, six attachment normals and corner-offset openings.
Runtime tests cover convex rounded contact, sliding, empty surrounding bounds, true room overlap, relay-door reset and actual scout pursuit.

Production browser picks/styles the sloped floor, undoes invalid reshaping, recovers/exports/imports and previews. Return from active preview uses the documented Escape release before the outer button.
Development browser authors a combined slope/sideways corridor and relay door, exports/imports, flies normally to completion and returns identical JSON.
Initial focused test refined the disabled-option assertion to its native DOM property and added the documented pointer-lock release; final full suite has zero retries.
A final menu-only refinement is checked separately below; gameplay assets are recorded for comparison.
No dependencies changed; no fresh audit/hardware capture, hosted CI, commit, push or deployment.
